title: Oracle Security Update Patches Critical WebLogic, Hyperion and Fusion Middleware Flaws
content_md: Oracle has released its August 2026 Critical Security Patch Update, delivering 943 new security patches across its products. The release demands immediate attention from enterprises running Oracle WebLogic Server , Hyperion Enterprise Performance Management products, and Fusion Middleware services, where remotely exploitable vulnerabilities could compromise sensitive business systems. Oracle said customers should deploy the fixes without delay, noting that attackers have successfully exploited previously patched Oracle vulnerabilities when organizations failed to apply the available updates. Oracle Security Update Patches Multiple Flaws WebLogic Server is among the most significant products affected. Oracle addressed multiple severe flaws in its core components across WebLogic Server 12.2.1.4.0, 14.1.1.0.0, 14.1.2.0.0, and 15.1.1.0.0. Several are remotely exploitable without authentication and carry CVSS scores of 9.8, meaning an unauthenticated attacker could potentially compromise confidentiality, integrity, and availability over the network. CVE-2026-60698 affects the WebLogic Server Core through IIOP, while CVE-2026-60672 and CVE-2026-60696 affect Core services exposed through T3 and IIOP. Oracle also patched CVE-2026-60977 in WLS Core Components over RMI. All four critical entries have a 9.8 CVSS score and require no authentication, making externally exposed middleware deployments a priority for patching.
